description: Curated DPI bypass strategy presets. Sources: bol-van/zapret (v1 nfqws), IndeecFOX/zapret4rocket (v1 curated, 1.1k stars), 1andrevich/homeproxy-hiddify (v2 + ByeDPI). Zapret2 (nfqws2) entries use Tachyon-native lua-desync syntax; zapret (nfqws) entries use classic --dpi-desync flags. ByeDPI entries use ciadpi short flags.
